tdsProducts.summary: Heat-cure two-part thermally conductive, electrically insulating epoxy designed for lid-sealing hermetic micro-electronic packages; near-hermetic MEMS seals and UHV-compatible.
cautions: Filled thermal system must be stirred thoroughly before mixing; settled filler will otherwise skew thermal and mechanical properties.
Service < 350 C is intermittent per TDS; Tg is only >= 80 C, so continuous-load service should stay well below that.
Passes ASTM E595 outgassing only with proper cure; abbreviated cures will not hit vacuum-grade performance.
tdsProducts.cureDetail: 100:15 by weight; recommended cure 150 C / 1 hour; alternative 2-step 100 C / 1 hour then 120 C / 2 hours
tdsProducts.name: H77

tdsProducts.summary: Room-temperature curable two-part epoxy with exceptionally wide -60 F to +450 F service range; low exotherm castable up to 2-3 inches, clear/amber with good optical transmission.
cautions: Room-temperature cure is rated but slow (48-72 hours); heat cure is required for the full strength and temperature range.
Castable up to 2-3 inches because exotherm is low for an epoxy, but large masses should still be monitored for peak temperature.
Hardness is rated > 75 Shore D; very rigid, not intended for flexible or impact-loaded joints.
tdsProducts.cureDetail: 100:40 by weight (or 100:50 by volume); 48-72 hours at 75 F, or 2-3 hours at 200 F; optimal is ambient cure plus 3-5 hour post-cure at 225-300 F
tdsProducts.name: EP42HT-2

tdsProducts.summary: Two-part addition-cure optically clear silicone potting and encapsulation compound; 220-2,500 nm transmission with long pot life for LED and fiber-optic cladding applications.
cautions: Addition-cure silicones are poisoned by amine, sulfur, tin, and some metal catalysts; qualify adjacent materials before potting.
Shore A 50-60 elastomer; not a structural adhesive, and peel-from-substrate is expected on smooth non-primed surfaces.
Optical transmission depends on bubble-free dispense; vacuum degas the mixed compound before potting optics.
tdsProducts.cureDetail: 10:1 by weight; 24-48 hours at 75 F or 1-2 hours at 200 F; 100% solids, no by-products released during cure
tdsProducts.name: MasterSil 151

tdsProducts.summary: Toughened thermally conductive, electrically insulating two-part epoxy with 1:1 mix and very wide -112 F to +400 F service range; good for bonding dissimilar substrates under thermal cycling.

tdsProducts.potLifeConditions: 100 g open time about 20-30 minutes
tdsProducts.viscosityUnit: cP for Part A; Part B paste
cautions: TDS lists Shore D 80-85 after full cure; rigid enough to transmit stress into brittle substrates if the stack is poorly designed.

Thermally conductive / electrically insulative balance holds only if the thick-section cure schedule is followed.
tdsProducts.cureDetail: 1:1 by weight or volume; 8-12 hours at 75 F plus 1-2 hours at 150-200 F for optimum; 100 g open time about 20-30 minutes
tdsProducts.name: Supreme 11AOHT

tdsProducts.summary: Toughened two-part epoxy with forgiving 1:1 mix, NASA low-outgassing pass, and -100 F to +350 F service range for bonding dissimilar substrates under thermal cycling.
